claim: The default way a CloudWatch alarm treats missing data is missing: if all data points in the evaluation range are missing, the alarm goes to INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Alarms that evaluate metrics in the AWS/DynamoDB namespace default to ignore missing data instead.

evidence.quote: `missing` – If all data points in the alarm evaluation range are missing, the alarm transitions to INSUFFICIENT\_DATA.
Alarms that evaluate metrics in the `AWS/DynamoDB` namespace default to ignore missing data.
